items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of rehabilitation application
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
items.computation: Letter dated 2025-03-11, sent by ordinary post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (posted since 2025): Sat 2025-03-15 (no weekend shift for the delivery day). Counting starts 2025-03-16 (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). One month later ends 2025-04-15 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), a Tuesday and a working day in NW, so no shift. The Widerspruch must reach the office by then.

warnings: If the letter was formally served (yellow envelope or a stated service date), the period runs from that date instead and may end earlier.
The Widerspruch must be in writing or recorded in person at the office; an email is not clearly sufficient, so send it in a way that proves receipt.
